app.name: Grade 12 Model Exams
app.tagline: Practice for the national exam with timed model exams.

common.errorGeneric: Please check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Telegram account to sign in.
login.devHint: Test users created in the dev project's dashboard

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.subtitle: We need a few details before you can take exams.
profile.fullNameHint: As it should appear on results and the leaderboard.
profile.streamWarning: Choose carefully: after saving, only an admin can change your stream.
profile.streamLocked: Only an admin can change your stream.

dashboard.adminLiveEmpty: No published exams with an open window. Drafts and exams for another stream don't appear here. Create or publish one in Admin → Exams.
dashboard.clockNote: Once you start, the clock keeps running. You cannot pause it. Start early: the exam closes at the time shown, even if your time is not finished.
dashboard.missedBody: If something stopped you from taking an exam, like a power cut or illness, you can ask for a re-exam. Find the exam below and tap “Request a re-exam”.

exams.title: Your exams
exams.subtitle: Upcoming, finished and missed exams.
exams.emptyAll: No exams yet. Check back soon.

result.publishedLater: Results will be published when the exam closes
result.lockedHint: Score, rank and correct answers appear here automatically when the exam closes for everyone.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.lockedHint: The leaderboard opens automatically when the exam closes for everyone.

state.closedRequest: Exam closed. Missed it? You can request a re-exam.
state.reexamPending: Exam closed – your re-exam request is pending.

reexam.pending: Exam closed – your re-exam request is pending.
reexam.approved: Re-exam approved. It will appear here when it is scheduled.
reexam.rejected: Your re-exam request was not approved.

reexamRequest.body: Choose the exam and the reason, then tell us what happened. An admin will read your request.
reexamRequest.placeholder: e.g. I was in hospital on the exam day.
reexamRequest.approvedHint: The re-exam has different question and answer order and its own leaderboard.
reexamRequest.sent: Request sent. An admin will read it. You can see the answer in “Your re-exam requests” below.

list.title: Your re-exam requests
list.subtitle: Your requests and the admin's answers.

rules.notAvailable: This exam isn't available to you.
rules.oneAttempt: One attempt only. You cannot restart once you begin.
rules.retake: This is your approved retake. One more attempt only.
rules.autosave: Answers save automatically on every tap, even if your connection drops.
rules.autoSubmit: When time runs out, your answers are submitted automatically.
rules.shortened_one: The window closes soon: you will only have {{count}} minute.
rules.shortened_other: The window closes soon: you will only have {{count}} minutes.

room.offlineBanner: Offline – answers saved on this phone. They will sync when you reconnect.
room.lowTimeUnanswered_one: Less than 5 minutes left and {{count}} question is unanswered.
room.lowTimeUnanswered_other: Less than 5 minutes left and {{count}} questions are unanswered.
room.submitFinal: You cannot change your answers after submitting.
room.submittingBody: Sending your answers. Please keep this page open.
room.submitRetrying: No connection. Your answers are saved on this phone; we will keep trying. Please reconnect.
room.timeUpBody: Your answers are being submitted automatically.

done.title: Exam submitted
done.body: Your answers were submitted. Results appear on your dashboard.
done.lateBody: Time ran out before your last answers reached the server. Everything saved before the deadline was submitted.

errors.exam_not_found: This exam isn't available to you.
errors.not_open: This exam is not open right now.
errors.time_up: Time is up for this exam.
errors.invalid_answers: Some answers could not be saved.
errors.no_result: You have no result for this exam yet.
errors.not_closed: You can request a re-exam only after the exam has closed.
errors.request_pending: You already have a pending request for this exam.
errors.request_approved: Your re-exam for this exam was already approved.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been suspended. Please contact the admin.

overview.tagline: Here's how your model exams are doing today.
overview.noLive: No exam is live right now.

students.title: Students

ban.title: Ban {{name}}?
ban.body: They are signed out of everything, can't sign in, and drop off leaderboards. If they are writing an exam now, it is closed immediately with the answers saved so far.
ban.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Shared answers during the exam
ban.doneClosed_one: Student banned. Their exam in progress was closed.
ban.doneClosed_other: Student banned. {{count}} exams in progress were closed.

unban.title: Unban {{name}}?
unban.body: They can sign in and take exams again. An exam that was closed by the ban stays closed (grant a retake if needed).

students.streamChangeHint: Changing the stream changes which exams they see.

retake.title: Retake grants
retake.grantBody: Allowed only until results are released. They can use it in any open window (add a restricted window for them if none is left).
retake.hint: Grant retakes from the Results tab or the student's page.
retake.lockedReleased: Results are released, so no more retakes. Use a re-exam instead.

requests.title: Re-exam requests
requests.approveBody: They are added to the open re-exam of “{{title}}”. If there is none, a draft re-exam is created (shuffled copy) for you to schedule.
requests.rejectBody: The student sees the status and your note on their dashboard.
requests.approvedNew: Approved. A new draft re-exam was created: open it from Exams to set its window and publish.
requests.approvedExisting: Approved. The student was added to the existing re-exam.

results.adminBeforeRelease: Results are not released yet. You see them as admin; students see nothing until every window has ended.
results.tableCaption: Results, one row per student (latest attempt)
results.questionStatsHint: Over ranked students' latest attempts. A popular wrong option can mean a misleading question or a wrong key.

reexam.title: Re-exams
reexam.hint: A re-exam is a new exam: the same questions in a new order with shuffled options. Only approved students can see it, and it has its own results and leaderboard.
reexam.notYet: Re-exams can be created after results are released. Before that, extend the window or add a new window in Windows & retakes.
reexam.createBody: A draft copy with shuffled questions and options is created. Add students and set its window before publishing. The original exam and its results are not changed.
reexam.approvedHint: Only these students can see and take this re-exam.
reexam.noStudents: No students yet. Approve requests or add students below.
reexam.draftHint: This re-exam is a draft. Set its window and publish it in the editor.
reexam.editorBody_one: {{count}} approved student can see it once published.
reexam.editorBody_other: {{count}} approved students can see it once published.

manage.released: Results are released (every window has ended).
manage.releaseAt: Results are released at {{time}} (end of the last window).
manage.windowsHint: Times are EAT. Extending or adding a window also moves the results release time.
manage.windowsLockedReleased: Results are released, so windows can no longer change (released results are never hidden again). Use Re-exams for students who missed it.
manage.windowsDraft: This exam is a draft. Set its window in the editor.
manage.extendConfirmBody: It will close at {{to}} instead of {{from}}. Students whose time was cut short by the old closing time get the rest of their duration.
manage.extended_one: Extended. {{count}} student in progress got more time.
manage.extended_other: Extended. {{count}} students in progress got more time.
manage.addWindowHint: For students who couldn't make the main window, before results are released.
manage.allowedStudents: Students who may use this window
manage.openWindowHint: Open to every student of this stream who hasn't taken it yet (and to students with a retake).
manage.addWindowConfirmRestricted_one: {{count}} student can start between {{start}} and {{end}}. Results stay hidden until it ends.
manage.addWindowConfirmRestricted_other: {{count}} students can start between {{start}} and {{end}}. Results stay hidden until it ends.
manage.addWindowConfirmOpen: Every eligible student can start between {{start}} and {{end}}. Results stay hidden until it ends.

exams.emptyAll: No exams yet. Create the first one.
exams.restoredDraft: Restored your unsaved exam from this device.
exams.clockAhead: This computer's clock is {{time}} ahead of the server. Exam times are checked against the server clock (now {{server}}).
exams.clockBehind: This computer's clock is {{time}} behind the server. Exam times are checked against the server clock (now {{server}}).
exams.liveEditWarning: This exam is live. Students can start at any moment; once anyone starts, only answer keys can be changed.
exams.noQuestionsYet: No questions yet. Add them with the form above.

fields.title: Title
fields.subject: Subject
fields.windowHint: Times are East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3). Students can start any time inside the window; late starters get less time.

upload.title: Import questions from a file
upload.hint: Excel, CSV or Word (.docx) up to {{mb}} MB, or a typed PDF up to {{pdfMb}} MB. Drag the file here or choose it.
upload.columns: Columns: # · Question · A · B · C · D · Answer (A–D) · Points (optional, default 1).
upload.reviewHint: Nothing is saved yet. The questions go into the list below, where anything that needs fixing is flagged.
upload.confirmReplaceBody_one: The {{count}} question already in this exam will be removed and replaced by the questions from {{file}}. Nothing is saved until you save the exam.
upload.confirmReplaceBody_other: The {{count}} questions already in this exam will be removed and replaced by the questions from {{file}}. Nothing is saved until you save the exam.
upload.imported_one: Imported {{count}} question from {{file}}. Check the list, then save.
upload.imported_other: Imported {{count}} questions from {{file}}. Check the list, then save.

errors.type: Choose an Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Word (.docx) or PDF file.
errors.tooBig: That file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
errors.empty: The file has no questions in it.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.unreadable: Couldn't read that file. Make sure it isn't damaged and is a normal Excel, CSV, Word or PDF file.
errors.oldXls: Old Excel files (.xls) can't be read. In Excel, use File → Save As → Excel Workbook (.xlsx), then import that.
errors.oldDoc: Old Word files (.doc) can't be read. In Word, use File → Save As → Word Document (.docx), then import that.
errors.noQuestionsFound: No numbered questions found. Number each question (1., 2., …), write the options as A. to D., and add "Answer: B". The Word template shows the format.
errors.tooManyQuestions: The file has more than {{max}} questions. Split it into smaller files.
errors.scanned: This PDF looks scanned (an image). Please upload a typed PDF or Word file.
errors.pdfPassword: This PDF is password-protected. Save a copy without a password and try again.

warnings.noHeader: No header row found, so columns were read in order: # · Question · A · B · C · D · Answer · Points.
warnings.badAnswer: Row {{row}}: answer "{{value}}" isn't A, B, C or D. Set it in the list below.
warnings.badPoints: Row {{row}}: points "{{value}}" must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
warnings.badAnswerQ: Question {{number}}: answer "{{value}}" isn't A, B, C or D. Set it in the list below.
warnings.keyConflict: Question {{number}}: the Answer line says {{line}} but the answer key says {{key}}. {{line}} was kept; check it.
warnings.keyUnknown: The answer key has answers for questions that aren't in the file: {{numbers}}.
warnings.optionOrder: Question {{number}}: the options aren't in A, B, C, D order. Check them.
warnings.imagesSkipped_one: Question {{numbers}} has a picture in the file. Add it with Edit after importing.
warnings.imagesSkipped_other: Questions {{numbers}} have pictures in the file. Add them with Edit after importing.
warnings.equationsSkipped_one: The file has {{count}} equation that was not imported. Find the question with a gap and retype it.
warnings.equationsSkipped_other: The file has {{count}} equations that were not imported. Find the questions with gaps and retype them.
warnings.scannedPages_one: Page {{pages}} has almost no text (it may be a scanned picture). Its questions may be missing.
warnings.scannedPages_other: Pages {{pages}} have almost no text (they may be scanned pictures). Their questions may be missing.
warnings.twoColumns_one: Page {{pages}} looks like it has two columns. Questions from both columns can get mixed up: check them, or import the Word file instead.
warnings.twoColumns_other: Pages {{pages}} look like they have two columns. Questions from both columns can get mixed up: check them, or import the Word file instead.

upload.wordExample:
1. Question text
A. option
B. option
C. option
D. option
Answer: B
upload.wordKeyHint: Options can also be on one line (A. … B. … C. … D. …), and "A)", "(A)" or "a." work too. Instead of Answer lines you can end with an answer key: "Answer key: 1-B, 2-C, 3-A".
upload.pdfHint: PDF: typed PDFs only, not scans. Pages with two columns may come out in the wrong order.
upload.noImages: Pictures and equations are not imported. Add pictures to each question after importing.
upload.noImagesAfter: Pictures and equations in the file were not imported. Use Edit on a question to add its picture, and retype any equation.
upload.needFix_one: {{count}} needs fixing. It's marked in the list after you add the questions.
upload.needFix_other: {{count}} need fixing. They're marked in the list after you add the questions.
upload.allComplete: Every question has text, 4 options and an answer.
upload.sourceSaveFailed: The questions were added, but the original file couldn't be saved ({{message}}). Import it again later to keep a copy.

form.question: Question
form.correctHint: Tap the circle next to the correct answer.

locked.title_one: {{count}} student has already started this exam
locked.title_other: {{count}} students have already started this exam
locked.body: Questions, options and timing are locked. You can still correct answer keys; submitted attempts are re-graded automatically.
locked.bar: Only the answer key can be changed.

confirm.discardTitle: Discard the unsaved exam on this device?
confirm.deleteExamBody: "{{title}}" and all its questions will be permanently deleted.
confirm.publishBody: {{count}} questions. Students will see it and can start between {{start}} and {{end}}.
confirm.unpublishBody: Students will no longer see it until you publish again.
confirm.keysBody: {{count}} answer key(s) will change and all {{attempts}} submitted attempt(s) will be re-graded.

exams.editorSubtitle: Set the details and the time window, then add the questions.

section1.title: Exam details & timings
section1.subtitle: Name, stream, length and when students can start.

section2.title: Questions & scoring
section2.subtitle: Import questions from Excel or write them one by one.

server.label: Server time
server.body: Exam windows, timers and automatic submission use the server clock, not this computer's clock.

problems.title: Title must be 3–200 characters
problems.subject: Subject must be 2–80 characters
problems.windowOrder: Window must close after it opens
problems.windowTooShort: Window is shorter than the exam duration
problems.windowEnded: Window has already closed (server time). Move the window into the future to publish

home.title: Practice for the national exam with timed model exams
home.lead: Take model exams on your phone, with a time limit like on exam day. When the exam closes, you see your score, the correct answers and your rank.

timed.title: Timed like exam day
timed.body: The time is checked on our server, not on your phone.

telegram.title: Sign in with Telegram
telegram.body: One tap. No password to remember.

results.title: Score and rank
results.body: You see them when the exam closes for everyone.

phone.title: Works on slow data
phone.body: Small pages that load on any phone.

signIn.title: Start practicing
signIn.body: Use your Telegram account to sign in.

podium.title: Top students
podium.privacy: To keep students safe, we show only the first name and one letter of the last name. Sign in to see the full leaderboard.

signIn.title: Sign in with Telegram
signIn.body: Tap the button and confirm in Telegram. Then add your name, school and stream.

wait.title: Wait for the exam to open
wait.body: Each exam opens at a set time. Your page shows when it starts.

take.title: Take the timed exam
take.body: Answer on your phone. Your answers are saved as you go. When time is up, they are sent for you.

results.title: See your score and rank
results.body: When the exam closes for everyone, you see your score, the correct answers and your rank.

cta.title: Ready for exam day?
cta.body: Sign in and take your next model exam.
